spec.description: Consumption, battery and usage of the e-208 over a selectable time range, with regression trendlines.
Kilometres of all trips in the time range; the sparkline is the weekly distance.
spec.title: Distance

spec.rawSql:
with c as (
    select time_bucket('1 ${grain}', start_at, 'Europe/Vienna') as time, sum(consumption) / sum(distance) * 100 as consumption
    from data_vehicle_trips
    where $__timeFilter(start_at) and distance >= ${min_km} and consumption > 0
    group by 1
), t as (
    select time_bucket('1 ${grain}', time, 'Europe/Vienna') as time, percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by air_temp) as temp
    from data_vehicle_environment_airtemp
    where $__timeFilter(time)
    group by 1
)
select c.time, c.consumption as "Consumption", t.temp as "Outside temperature"
from c left join t using (time)
order by 1;

spec.description: Per ${grain}: the energy of all trips divided by their distance (bars, colour by level) and the median outside temperature the car reported (line, right axis). The red line is a polynomial regression (degree 4) over the bars. Winter costs about a quarter more energy than summer.
spec.title: Consumption and outside temperature

spec.rawSql:
with t as (
    select (time at time zone 'Europe/Vienna')::date as d, percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by air_temp) as temp
    from data_vehicle_environment_airtemp
    where $__timeFilter(time)
    group by 1
), b as (
    select round(t.temp / 2) * 2 as x, sum(v.consumption) / sum(v.distance) * 100 as y, count(*) as n
    from data_vehicle_trips v join t on t.d = (v.start_at at time zone 'Europe/Vienna')::date
    where $__timeFilter(v.start_at) and v.distance >= ${min_km} and v.consumption > 0
    group by 1
), s as (
    select count(*) as n, sum(x) as sx, sum(x ^ 2) as sx2, sum(x ^ 3) as sx3, sum(x ^ 4) as sx4, sum(y) as sy, sum(x * y) as sxy, sum(x ^ 2 * y) as sx2y from b where n >= 10
), c as (
    select ((s.sy) * ((s.sx2) * (s.sx4) - (s.sx3) * (s.sx3)) - (s.sx) * ((s.sxy) * (s.sx4) - (s.sx3) * (s.sx2y)) + (s.sx2) * ((s.sxy) * (s.sx3) - (s.sx2) * (s.sx2y))) / ((s.n) * ((s.sx2) * (s.sx4) - (s.sx3) * (s.sx3)) - (s.sx) * ((s.sx) * (s.sx4) - (s.sx3) * (s.sx2)) + (s.sx2) * ((s.sx) * (s.sx3) - (s.sx2) * (s.sx2))) as a0,
       ((s.n) * ((s.sxy) * (s.sx4) - (s.sx3) * (s.sx2y)) - (s.sy) * ((s.sx) * (s.sx4) - (s.sx3) * (s.sx2)) + (s.sx2) * ((s.sx) * (s.sx2y) - (s.sxy) * (s.sx2))) / ((s.n) * ((s.sx2) * (s.sx4) - (s.sx3) * (s.sx3)) - (s.sx) * ((s.sx) * (s.sx4) - (s.sx3) * (s.sx2)) + (s.sx2) * ((s.sx) * (s.sx3) - (s.sx2) * (s.sx2))) as a1,
       ((s.n) * ((s.sx2) * (s.sx2y) - (s.sxy) * (s.sx3)) - (s.sx) * ((s.sx) * (s.sx2y) - (s.sxy) * (s.sx2)) + (s.sy) * ((s.sx) * (s.sx3) - (s.sx2) * (s.sx2))) / ((s.n) * ((s.sx2) * (s.sx4) - (s.sx3) * (s.sx3)) - (s.sx) * ((s.sx) * (s.sx4) - (s.sx3) * (s.sx2)) + (s.sx2) * ((s.sx) * (s.sx3) - (s.sx2) * (s.sx2))) as a2
    from s
)
select b.x as "Temperature", b.y as "Consumption", c.a0 + c.a1 * b.x + c.a2 * b.x ^ 2 as "Quadratic fit"
from b, c
order by b.x;

spec.description: Each point is a 2 °C band of the median daily outside temperature (every band that has trips, from the coldest to the warmest measured): the energy of all trips of those days divided by their distance. The red line is a quadratic least-squares fit through the bands with at least 10 trips; outside them it is an extrapolation and the points rest on few trips. It shows how much range the cold takes.
spec.title: Consumption against outside temperature

spec.rawSql:
select (floor(speed_average / 10) * 10)::int || ' - ' || (floor(speed_average / 10) * 10 + 10)::int as "Average speed (km/h)", sum(consumption) / sum(distance) * 100 as "Consumption", floor(speed_average / 10) as sort
from data_vehicle_trips
where $__timeFilter(start_at) and distance >= ${min_km} and consumption > 0 and speed_average > 0
group by 1, sort
having count(*) >= 10
order by sort;

spec.description: The energy of all trips divided by their distance, grouped by the trip's average speed in 10 km/h bands (bands with at least 10 trips). Town traffic and motorway speed both cost more than the middle.
spec.title: Consumption by average speed

spec.rawSql:
with trips as (
    select date_trunc('month', start_at at time zone 'Europe/Vienna')::date as month,
           sum(consumption) as kwh,
           sum(distance) as km
    from data_vehicle_trips
    where distance > 0 and consumption > 0
    group by 1
), overall as (
    select sum(kwh) / sum(km) * 100 as kwh_per_100km from trips
)
select (w.month + 14)::timestamp at time zone 'Europe/Vienna' as time,
       w.price_fuel / w.km * 100 as "Combustion car",
       w.price_car / nullif(w.energy_car, 0) * coalesce(t.kwh / t.km * 100, o.kwh_per_100km) as "EV"
from agg_1month_what_if w
left join trips t on t.month = w.month
cross join overall o
where w.km > 0
  and w.month >= date_trunc('month', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz at time zone 'Europe/Vienna')
  and w.month < $__timeTo()::timestamptz at time zone 'Europe/Vienna'
order by time;

spec.description: Combustion car: the reference car's fuel (km x l/100 km x the day's fuel price) per driven km, from agg_1month_what_if. EV: the average price per kWh paid for home charging that month (grid share at the hourly price, PV energy free) times the car's consumption from its trips (data_vehicle_trips, kWh/100 km), so km charged away from home are priced as if charged at home. Months without trips use the average consumption over all trips. The trip consumption leaves out charging losses. The red line is a polynomial regression (degree 5) over the EV bars, as on Average Consumption.
spec.title: Cost per 100 km: combustion car vs EV

spec.description: Number of trips in the time range; the sparkline is the weekly count.
spec.title: Trips

spec.rawSql:
select time_bucket('1 day', time) as time, avg(soh) as "State of health"
from data_vehicle_battery_soh
where $__timeFilter(time)
group by 1
order by 1;

spec.description: Daily mean of the state of health the car reports (whole percent, so it moves in steps). The red line is a linear regression over the time range.
spec.title: Battery state of health

spec.rawSql:
select time_bucket('1 week', a.time, 'Europe/Vienna') as time, percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by a.autonomy / l.level * 100) as "Range at 100 %"
from data_vehicle_energy_autonomy a
join data_vehicle_energy_level l using (vehicle_id, time)
where $__timeFilter(a.time) and $__timeFilter(l.time) and l.level between 30 and 100
group by 1
order by 1;

spec.description: Weekly median of the car's range estimate scaled to a full battery (range divided by charge level, for levels between 30 and 100 %). The estimate follows the temperature and the recent driving style. The red line is a polynomial regression (degree 4).
spec.title: Estimated range at 100 %

spec.rawSql:
select case when level >= 100 then '100' else (floor(level / 10) * 10)::int || ' - ' || (floor(level / 10) * 10 + 10)::int end as "Charge level (%)",
       count(*) * 100.0 / sum(count(*)) over () as "Share of time", floor(level / 10) as sort
from data_vehicle_energy_level
where $__timeFilter(time)
group by 1, sort
order by sort;

spec.description: Share of the car's charge-level readings (every 5 minutes) per 10 % band. Batteries age slowest when they rest between about 20 and 80 %.
spec.title: Time at each charge level

spec.rawSql:
with m as (
    select time_bucket('1 ${grain}', start_at, 'Europe/Vienna') as time, sum(distance) * ${battery_kwh} / sum(consumption) as measured
    from data_vehicle_trips
    where $__timeFilter(start_at) and distance >= ${min_km} and consumption > 0
    group by 1
), r as (
    select time_bucket('1 ${grain}', a.time, 'Europe/Vienna') as time, percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by a.autonomy / l.level * 100) as reported
    from data_vehicle_energy_autonomy a
    join data_vehicle_energy_level l using (vehicle_id, time)
    where $__timeFilter(a.time) and $__timeFilter(l.time) and l.level between 30 and 100
    group by 1
)
select m.time, m.measured as "Measured range at 100 %", r.reported as "Reported range at 100 %"
from m left join r using (time)
order by 1;

spec.description: Range the trips actually delivered, scaled to a full battery: distance divided by the energy used, times the battery capacity (${battery_kwh} kWh, the battery_power of the car in cars.json; the dashboard constant battery_kwh must match it). The trips' energy is the level drop times that capacity, so the capacity cancels out and the result is simply 100 divided by the share of the battery a kilometre costs. Per ${grain}, over all trips of the time range. The green line is the range the car reports (see Estimated range at 100 %). The red line is a polynomial regression (degree 3) over the measured range. The measured range is lower than the reported one, since the reported value assumes gentle driving.
spec.title: Measured range at 100 %

spec.rawSql:
select time_bucket('1 week', start_at, 'Europe/Vienna') as time, sum(consumption) as "Energy"
from data_vehicle_trips
where $__timeFilter(start_at) and distance >= ${min_km} and consumption > 0
group by 1
order by 1;

spec.description: Energy of all trips in the time range as the car reports it, without charging losses; the sparkline is the weekly energy.
spec.title: Energy used

spec.rawSql:
select time_bucket('1 day', time, 'Europe/Vienna') as time, max(mileage) as "Odometer"
from data_vehicle_mileage
where $__timeFilter(time)
group by 1
order by 1;

spec.description: Daily maximum of the odometer reading. The red line is a linear regression over the time range; its slope is the Yearly mileage above.
spec.title: Odometer

spec.rawSql:
with c as (
    select extract(isodow from start_at at time zone 'Europe/Vienna')::int as dow, extract(hour from start_at at time zone 'Europe/Vienna')::int as hour
    from data_vehicle_trips
    where $__timeFilter(start_at) and distance >= ${min_km}
)
select lpad(c.hour::text, 2, '0') || ':00' as "Hour",
       nullif(count(*) filter (where c.dow = 1), 0) as "Mon",
       nullif(count(*) filter (where c.dow = 2), 0) as "Tue",
       nullif(count(*) filter (where c.dow = 3), 0) as "Wed",
       nullif(count(*) filter (where c.dow = 4), 0) as "Thu",
       nullif(count(*) filter (where c.dow = 5), 0) as "Fri",
       nullif(count(*) filter (where c.dow = 6), 0) as "Sat",
       nullif(count(*) filter (where c.dow = 7), 0) as "Sun"
from c
where c.hour between 6 and 20
group by c.hour
order by c.hour;

spec.description: When the car is used: the number of trips by hour of the day and weekday they started, in the time range, from 06:00 to 20:59 (the few trips outside that window are left out). The darker the cell, the more trips; empty cells have none.
spec.title: Trips by weekday and hour

spec.description: Number of trips by distance in 5 km bands. Most trips are short; the few long ones carry much of the distance.
spec.title: Trip length distribution

spec.rawSql:
select (extract(year from year)::int || case when year = date_trunc('year', now() at time zone 'Europe/Vienna')::date then ' (to date)' else '' end) as "Year",
       case when not estimated then km end as "Measured", case when estimated then km end as "Estimated"
from agg_1year_what_if
where km > 0
order by year;

spec.description: Distance driven per calendar year from agg_1year_what_if, the same figure as the savings calculation. It ignores the time range and the Shortest trip filter. The current year is the year to date. Years that include months before the first odometer reading (2022-12 to 2024-02, from the purchase on 2022-12-01) are estimates and drawn lighter.
spec.title: Kilometres per calendar year

spec.description: Energy of all trips divided by their distance, so every trip counts by its kilometres.
spec.title: Consumption

spec.rawSql:
select time, grid_kw as "Grid import", limit_kw as "Limit", goe_kw as "Charger power", step_kw as "Chosen step"
from data_charging_decision
where $__timeFilter(time)
order by time;

spec.description: One point per minute while a car is connected and the charging mode is auto. Grid import stays under the limit by lowering the charger's step; the step is raised again only after five minutes of room.
spec.title: Auto charging: grid import against the limit

spec.rawSql:
select time as "Time", round(grid_kw::numeric, 1) as "Grid kW", round(house_kw::numeric, 1) as "House kW", round(goe_kw::numeric, 1) as "Charger kW",
  round(limit_kw::numeric, 1) as "Limit kW", round(room_kw::numeric, 1) as "Room kW", phases || ' x ' || ampere || ' A' as "Step", round(step_kw::numeric, 1) as "Step kW"
from data_charging_decision
where $__timeFilter(time) and changed
order by time desc
limit 200;

spec.description: Every minute the auto mode changed the charger's step: the readings it used and the step it chose. Room = limit - (grid import - charger power).
spec.title: Auto charging: step changes

spec.rawSql:
with cur as (
    select sum(consumption) / sum(distance) as c from data_vehicle_trips
    where $__timeFilter(start_at) and distance >= ${min_km} and consumption > 0
), prev as (
    select sum(consumption) / sum(distance) as c from data_vehicle_trips
    where start_at >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz)
      and start_at < $__timeFrom()::timestamptz and distance >= ${min_km} and consumption > 0
)
select now() as time, (cur.c / prev.c - 1) * 100 as "Change"
from cur, prev
where prev.c is not null;

spec.description: Change of the consumption against the period of the same length right before the time range. Down is better. Hidden when there is no earlier data.
spec.title: Consumption vs. previous period

spec.rawSql:
select time_bucket('1 day', time) as time, avg(soh) as "SOH"
from data_vehicle_battery_soh
where $__timeFilter(time)
group by 1
order by 1;

spec.description: Last state of health in the time range (the car reports whole percent); the sparkline is the daily mean.
spec.title: Battery state of health

spec.rawSql:
with d as (
    select extract(epoch from time_bucket('1 day', time)) as x, max(mileage) as y
    from data_vehicle_mileage
    where $__timeFilter(time)
    group by 1
)
select now() as time, regr_slope(y, x) * 365.25 * 86400 as "Yearly mileage"
from d;

spec.description: Slope of the linear regression through the daily odometer readings in the time range, in kilometres per year.
spec.title: Yearly mileage (trend)

spec.rawSql:
with d as (
    select extract(epoch from time_bucket('1 day', time)) as x, avg(soh) as y
    from data_vehicle_battery_soh
    where $__timeFilter(time)
    group by 1
), r as (
    select regr_slope(y, x) as s, regr_intercept(y, x) as b from d
)
select now() as time, to_char(to_timestamp((80 - b) / s) at time zone 'Europe/Vienna', 'YYYY-MM') as "Month"
from r
where s < 0;

spec.description: Month in which the linear regression through the daily state of health in the time range reaches 80 %. The car reports whole percent, so this is a rough estimate. Empty while the health is not declining.
spec.title: 80 % health reached (trend)
